title: Poetry
note: Quiet moral reckoning on guilt and beauty; profound restraint.

title: La La Land
note: Lush musical nostalgia; bittersweet ending lingers, ideas thin.

title: Seven Samurai
note: Foundational action grammar; humane, inexhaustible, formally commanding.

title: In the Mood for Love
note: Restraint and longing rendered as ravishing, durable form.

title: Parasite
note: Class allegory with controlled tonal mastery; broadly persuasive.

title: City Lights
note: Final recognition scene; comedy and pathos perfectly fused, indelible.

title: Spirited Away
note: Boundless imaginative animation; coming-of-age wonder that genuinely lingers.

title: The Godfather
note: American tragedy of corruption; operatic control, deep rewatch reward.

title: 12 Angry Men
note: Taut chamber drama on doubt and justice; somewhat schematic.

title: A Separation
note: Moral perspectivism; every party right and wrong, ethically exacting.

title: Portrait of a Lady on Fire
note: Gaze and memory theorized as image; controlled, ardent form.

title: Moonlight
note: Tender identity triptych; lyrical intimacy that returns for weeks.

title: 2001: A Space Odyssey
note: Perceptual reorganization of cinema and cosmos; rigorous, inexhaustible.

title: The Tree of Life
note: Grace versus nature in cosmic register; divisive but achieved.

title: Mulholland Drive
note: Dream-logic of desire and Hollywood; structurally rich, rewards rewatch.

title: Synecdoche, New York
note: Mortality and art's recursion; ambitious, melancholy, formally sprawling.

title: Jeanne Dielman
note: Duration as feminist method; reorganizes how time is filmed.

title: Antichrist
note: Grief and misogyny in extremis; striking yet provocateurish.

title: Holy Motors
note: Cinema-as-performance meditation; protean, exhilarating, formally adventurous.

title: Uncut Gems
note: Anxiety machine of compulsion; sustained tension, thematically narrow.

title: Beau Is Afraid
note: Maternal-guilt odyssey; ambitious sprawl undercut by indulgence, very divisive.

title: Close-Up
note: Cinema, truth, identity collapsed; a profound documentary-fiction inquiry.

title: Enemy
note: Doppelganger dread as control allegory; sleek, cryptic, debated.

title: Climax
note: Descent into bodily chaos; kinetic form, thin substance, provocateurish.

title: Batman Returns
note: Gothic auteur blockbuster; expressionist design, narratively unruly.

title: Top Gun: Maverick
note: Superb practical aerial craft; emotionally calculated, ideologically safe.

title: Ocean's Eleven
note: Effortless heist confection; stylish, breezy, deliberately weightless.

title: Ant-Man
note: Pleasant franchise heist comedy; formulaic, low durable yield.

title: John Wick
note: Choreographic action clarity and world-building; thematically minimal.

title: Crazy Rich Asians
note: Glossy rom-com with representational charge; conventional, crowd-aimed.

title: The Hangover
note: Effective gross-out farce; disposable, little lasting value.

title: Jurassic World
note: Nostalgia-recycling spectacle; hollow, self-aware yet cynical.

title: Knives Out
note: Clever genre-savvy whodunit with mild satire; entertaining, slight.

title: The Intouchables
note: Warm crowd-pleaser; sentimental uplift, racial dynamics smoothed over.

title: Free Guy
note: Amiable meta-game comedy; branded, conceptually shallow, safe.

title: Babylon
note: Maximalist Hollywood-excess elegy; ostentatious style outruns its insight.

title: Cloud Atlas
note: Grand reincarnation mosaic; earnest ambition, uneven, structurally overreaching.

title: The Counselor
note: Bleak nihilist parable; literate dialogue, alienating, genuinely split reception.

title: Joker
note: Scorsese-pastiche character study; provocation borrowed, sincerity contested, divisive.

title: Don't Look Up
note: Blunt climate satire; smug, didactic, preaches to converted.

title: Star Wars: The Last Jedi
note: Franchise subversion attempt; genuinely splits fans, thematically thoughtful, uneven.

title: Sucker Punch
note: Empowerment claim drowned in fetishized spectacle; incoherent, self-defeating.

title: Spring Breakers
note: Neon critique of hedonism; formally daring, complicit ambiguity, divisive.

title: The Fountain
note: Earnest mortality triptych; visually bold, overreaching, genuinely split.

title: Southland Tales
note: Sprawling apocalyptic satire; cult chaos, mostly incoherent, fiercely debated.

title: Suicide Squad
note: Studio-mangled mess; tonal incoherence, cynical, nothing durable remains.

title: Vox Lux
note: Pop-culture-and-violence essay; formally ambitious, cold, sharply polarizing.

title: Avatar: The Way of Water
note: Technical immersion landmark; spectacle outpaces thin story and theme.

title: Mamma Mia!
note: Buoyant jukebox froth; infectious yet negligible durable value.

title: Now You See Me
note: Flashy heist-magic trickery; hollow misdirection, cheats its own premise.
